Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Washington DC hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 28, 2026 snapshot, at 15 of the 18 Washington DC hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 3, Traveluro at 3, Vio.com at 3, KAYAK.com at 2, Tripadvisor.com at 2, goseek.com at 1 and trivago DEALS at 1. These are the Washington DC rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

Taxes and fees at Washington DC hotels

At the 16 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 16% ($25 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 13% at DoubleTree by Hilton Washington DC Silver Spring to 19% at Architect Hotel. At 2 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
